blocks.text: Is chapter mein aap data aur analysis (data ko parakhna) ki bunyadi baatein seekhenge, aur yeh bhi ke aaj ki computing mein in ki kya ahmiyat hai. Aap data science ki bunyad dekhenge aur data ki mukhtalif qismein samjhenge, jaise structured aur unstructured data, aur data collect (jama) karne aur store (mehfooz) karne ke tareeqe bhi. Chapter machine learning ka ta'aruf karata hai: aisa tareeqa jis mein system data se seekh kar faisle karta hai. Phir yeh batata hai ke model ki performance (karkardagi) accuracy, precision, recall aur F1-score jaise pemaanon se kaise jaanchi jati hai, aur validation aur tuning se model ko kaise behtar kiya jata hai. Aakhir mein Excel, R aur Python jaise aam tools aate hain jo data science aur machine learning mein istemal hote hain.

Data science woh field hai jo data collect karne, us ka analysis karne aur us se mufeed maloomat nikalne par kaam karti hai. Yeh raw data (kacha, be-tarteeb data) ko kaam ke ilm mein badalti hai. Data science tools aur tareeqon se bohat bara data parakhti hai. Yeh zindagi ke kai shobon mein decision-making (faisla karne) mein madad deti hai, aur future trends (aane wale rujhan) ka andaza lagane mein bhi. Business, taleem aur healthcare (sehat) mein is ka aam istemal hai. Aaj ki technology bohat had tak data science par chalti hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Bohat se idare (organizations) faisle karne ke liye data science istemal karte hain. Yeh data mein chhupe trends aur patterns (baar baar aane wale naqsh) samajhne mein madad deti hai.

blocks.alt: Teeron se jure chaar dabbe: 1 collection (jama aur process), 2 exploring (parakh aur safai), 3 modelling (train aur test) aur 4 decision making (baseerat aur amal). Decision making se wapas collection tak dashed purple feedback loop: nataij naye sawal aur naya data late hain. Note un shobon ki fehrist deta jin par data science mabni hai.
blocks.caption: Data science ka workflow (Fig 6.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Chakkar ahem hai: aik tajzie se jo seekha jaye woh aam taur par agla sawal uthata hai, is liye data science aik dafa nahi balke baar baar hoti hai.

blocks.text: Data science ka matlab hai data ko parh kar patterns aur mufeed maloomat dhoondna. Is mein mukhtalif sources (zaraye) se data jama kiya jata hai. Analysis se pehle data ko saaf aur tarteeb mein kiya jata hai. Analysis ke baad results (nataij) ko dhyan se samjha jata hai. Data science sawalon ke jawab facts aur data se deti hai, is liye faislon mein guesswork (andaze se kaam chalana) kam ho jata hai. Data science ka poora workflow (kaam ke qadmon ka silsila) Figure 6.1 mein dikhaya gaya hai. Data science data ko knowledge (ilm) mein badalti hai, aur yeh ilm asal zindagi ke masle hal karne mein kaam aata hai.

Data science kai subjects ka ilm milati hai. Mathematics se numbers aur hisab ka kaam hota hai. Statistics (shumariyat) data ka analysis aur khulasa karne mein madad deti hai. Computer science tools aur programming ki maharat deti hai. Domain knowledge (us shobe ka ilm jis ka masla hai, jaise tib ya business) asal masla samajhne ke liye zaroori hai. Communication skills (baat samjhane ki salahiyat) se results saaf saaf bataye jate hain. Isi milap ki wajah se data science ko interdisciplinary (kai shobon ko milane wali) kehte hain. Har shoba doosre ki madad karta hai, aur sab mil kar data analysis ko zyada asar-dar banate hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Figure 6.1 ke chaar qadam: (1) Data Collection: data jama aur process karna; (2) Data Analysis: data ko dekhna aur saaf karna; (3) Modeling: model ko train aur test karna; (4) Decision Making: results se faisle aur amal. Feedback Loop ka matlab: results se naye sawal paida hote hain aur kaam phir pehle qadam se shuru hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Data science ko interdisciplinary kyun kaha jata hai? Domain knowledge ki ek misal dein jo is ke liye zaroori ho.
blocks.explanation: Kyunke yeh mathematics, statistics, computer science, domain knowledge aur communication ko milati hai. Misal: hospital ke data ke analysis ke liye tibbi (medical) ilm chahiye, taake pata ho ke kaun si measurements aham hain aur result ka mareezon ke liye kya matlab hai.

items: Data science raw data ko faislon aur andazon ke kaam aane wale ilm mein badalti hai.
Workflow: data collection, data analysis (dekhna aur safai), modeling (train aur test), decision making; feedback loop se kaam dobara shuru.
Interdisciplinary: mathematics, statistics, computer science, domain knowledge aur communication.
